items.description: Tools that manage parallel CLI-agent sessions, terminals, issue boards, worktrees, diffs, and local review loops. These are useful for agentic coding work, but they are tracked separately from orchestrator/player entries when they do not manage agent teams or runtime behavior directly.

items.title: agent-manager
items.description: (GitHub) - Apache-2.0 terminal UI for macOS and Linux (Windows via WSL2) where Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and other coding-agent CLIs run side by side in persistent tmux sessions, with live status, prompts sent without attaching, optional per-session Git worktrees, and diff review that sends line comments back to the agent.

repo_info.description: The fastest developer workflow for every AI coding agent. Live status, quick prompts, worktrees, and diff review from one tmux TUI.

items.title: Coven
items.description: (GitHub, Docs) - MIT-licensed local-first Rust daemon and CLI that runs Codex, Claude Code, and other coding-agent harnesses as PTY sessions inside explicit project-root boundaries, with SQLite-persisted history and a versioned local socket API.

repo_info.description: Local-first runtime for project-scoped AI coding-agent sessions, with durable state, authority boundaries, and multi-harness interoperability.

items.title: CLI Agent Session Workspaces

items.description: Policy, permission, approval, budget, trust, reputation, settlement, and audit layers that sit between agent intent and execution. These are not orchestrators themselves; they govern actions routed through an orchestrator, framework, coding agent, MCP server, marketplace, exchange, or application runtime.

children.title: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit

repo_info.description: AI Agent Governance Toolkit — Policy enforcement, zero-trust identity, execution sandboxing, and reliability engineering for autonomous AI agents. Covers 10/10 OWASP Agentic Top 10.

children.title: Okto Pulse
children.description: (GitHub) - Elastic-2.0 local-first SDLC workbench with 17 enforced governance gates for AI coding agents, including independent validation, blocking evidence requirements, and spec-coverage checks before work reaches done.

repo_info.description: Local-first, spec-driven SDLC workbench with governance gates, knowledge graphs, and MCP for AI coding agents.

children.title: Veto
children.description: (GitHub) - Apache-2.0 authorization layer for AI agent tool calls, with TypeScript and Python SDKs, YAML policies, approval routing, and audit logs. Veto Cloud is commercial.

repo_info.description: The authorization kernel for AI agents. Block, allow, or escalate agent tool calls with YAML rules — deterministic-first, LLM fallback.

items.title: Governance And Enforcement

items.title: OrcaReplay
